name: council
description: Convene agency-agents specialists on one open decision, including architecture selection when a draft exists and the goal is to choose rather than edit. It records four named first positions before synthesis and compares challengers under a neutral brief; missing isolation lowers assurance instead of blocking the debate. Canonical Claude records may reach CONVERGED; weaker runs return unaudited, non-authorizing ADVISORY. Use review-loop to fix artifacts to APPROVE. Requires ~/.agency-agents.
